visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slider of customer review cards (avatar, reviewer name, date, source logo, star rating, review text) with the reviewed agent and a homepage link
visualCharacteristics.layout: Horizontal scroll-snap track, 1 card on mobile and 2 on desktop, prev/next buttons and page dots

contentPattern.structure: one row per review; cell 1: avatar image (or one-letter text), reviewer name (bold or heading), date line (e.g. am 16.11.2026 auf), optional source logo image, rating paragraph (5, 4,5/5 or ★★★★★), review text; cell 2 (optional): agent name, location line, optional badge image, homepage link

usage: Agent review slider on 72 pages (agency/advisor pages, e.g. https://www.ergo.de/de/Versicherung-vor-Ort/aachen, https://www.ergo.de/de/Versicherung-vor-Ort/Augsburg)
reuseGuidance: Use for review/testimonial sliders with a rating. Reviews are authored statically; a live Google/eKomi review feed is out of scope for now. For generic image or teaser sliders use carousel; for an eKomi rating summary use ekomi.
